card.name: Pieter
card.situation: Data engineer at a retail group. Ten years in data engineering, the last four at this company.
card.day_to_day: Looks after the nightly data pipelines that feed sales reports, and writes a lot of SQL.
card.strongest_skill: SQL and building reliable data pipelines.
card.skill_example: Rebuilt the nightly sales pipeline so the morning reports are ready by 6am instead of 10am.
card.wants_next: A senior data engineering role where he can design pipelines, not just maintain them.
card.work_arrangement: Wants hybrid, two or three days in the office.
card.salary_stance: Happy to share: about R85,000 a month.
card.behaviour: Rambles. Gives long, wandering answers with side stories. Never mentions any cloud platform (no AWS, Azure or Google Cloud), even when talking about pipelines.

summary.fact: Data engineer; no cloud platform invented

current_role.fact: Data engineer at a retail group

skills.fact: SQL and data pipelines, with the nightly sales pipeline as the example; no cloud platform
